title: os migrate meta --stored: list the stored permission sets whose View All / Modify All lost their field reach in 19 (follow-up of #36055 ruling A)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8wf3DSPRevwNnYLcM
Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet · follow-up of PR #37371 (#36055), the dev's interim report 7178352702 open question 1 (seat chose A)

## What

By maintainer ruling 7177446075 (#36055, option A), permission sets stored in `sys_metadata` take the 19 meaning: View All / Modify All no longer read a field another set hides, and the fix is `viewAllFields: true`. The ruling's execution note asks the upgrade text to give operators a one-step check of which stored sets are affected.

Read by the #36055 dev at its head: no command lists those sets today, and Studio's permission matrix has no `viewAllFields` control, so the only fix path for a stored set is the metadata API. PR #37371's changeset states the predicate (an `objects` entry, wildcard included, carrying `viewAllRecords` or `modifyAllRecords` and no `viewAllFields`) and that API fix.

## Proposed (for triage)

- `os migrate meta --stored` prints a review list of the stored permission sets matching that predicate (like the flow decision-mode review list of the `flow-decision-mode-inclusive-explicit` flip), naming set, object entry and the one-line fix. Read-only; it rewrites nothing (ruling A).
- Triage may split off the Studio half: a `viewAllFields` control in the permission matrix, so an administrator can restore a stored set without the API.

Blocked-by: #36055
Dedupe: searched 'viewAllFields stored review list', 'migrate meta stored permission' — no open card.
